quotes.text: C string literals are not supported in our MSRV.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Check the minimum supported Rust version before introducing new language syntax. In May2024 c string literals had to be replaced by cstr::cstr! even when other Rust edits were formatting. A reviewer reported the patch fixed a local build. This is compatibility evidence; it does not establish that c string literals remain forbidden after the supported compiler advances. Formatting and lint success do not replace compiler compatibility checks.
title: Choose Rust syntax supported by the configured compiler floor
